summary.text: Kathy Jennings is the incumbent Democratic Attorney General, first elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022. A former Delaware state prosecutor, she is seeking a third four-year term and says her priorities are public safety, consumer and corporate accountability, election protection and legal action against federal policies.

paragraphs.text: Began her career as a prosecutor in the Delaware Department of Justice, one of two women prosecutors there at the time, and later served as State Prosecutor.
Elected Attorney General in 2018 and re-elected in 2022; the first woman Democrat elected to the post, per her survey response.
